t: The Computer Port allows you to connect your Energizer to a computer, enabling you to gather information on the status of the Energizer.$(br2)A standard set of methods is exposed to the connected computer, and you can use them to query the status of the Energizer.
计算机端口可以让你将充能器连接到计算机上，从而获取有关充能器状态的信息。$(br2)连接的计算机会获得一组标准方法，你可以用它们来查询充能器的状态。
$(l)Mandatory:$() no$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() no
